hub.title: Fun & Learn Corner
hub.subtitle: Music, sentence building, and picture descriptions to help your child love Vietnamese.
hub.heading: Entertainment
hub.shooterDesc: Select words from the book and arrange them into a correct sentence.
hub.pictureImageAlt: A sunny garden for your child to observe and tell stories
hub.pictureDesc: Observe pictures from the book or uploaded photos. Your child can tell stories via voice or text to get vocabulary suggestions.
hub.karaokeDesc: Choose a favorite song, listen to the music, and sing along with the lyrics on screen.
hub.selectChildAria: Select child profile for the Play & Learn zone
hub.defaultGreeting: Hello little reader! Would you like to tell a picture story, build sentences, sing along, or play a memory game today?
hub.defaultRecommendationReason: Every activity gently connects with the books you are reading so you remember words longer without any pressure.
hub.magicQuestNoBookHint: No matching book yet? ViRead Owl weaves a 60-second magic story that clears right after play!
hub.onboardingRegionAria: Getting started guide for Play & Learn
hub.onboardingStep1Body: Four calm zones: Picture Storytelling, Sentence Shooter, Happy Karaoke, and What Do You Remember?
hub.onboardingStep2Body: Large, clear buttons that are easy to tap on phones and tablets. You can speak or pick words anytime.
hub.onboardingStep3Body: 10–15 minutes per session is ideal. No stressful countdowns — our AI Teacher and Owl always cheer you on!
hub.memoryDesc: Observe Vietnamese illustrations at your own pace, recall colors and positions, then imagine a fun continuation to the story!
hub.defaultBreakReminder: About 10–15 minutes per session keeps young eyes healthy and learning effortless.

FULL_SONG.label: Full Song
FULL_SONG.description: Sing the whole song and save your child's high-score record.

SEGMENT.label: Difficult Segment
SEGMENT.description: Loop a tricky part at 0.85x speed without overwriting your full-song record.

LINE_PRACTICE.label: Line by Line
LINE_PRACTICE.description: Pick each line to practice clear lyrics and steady rhythm.

RHYTHM_TAP.label: Rhythm Tap
RHYTHM_TAP.description: Tap the rhythm button or Spacebar on the beat — fun rhythm practice even without a mic!

musicalSummary.speakerBleedNote: Mild speaker bleed detected by microphone.
musicalSummary.insufficientHint: Not enough vocal signal to score musical performance this time. Bring the mic closer or try headphones!

score.praise90: Excellent! Your singing is very accurate!
score.praise70: Great job! You sang quite well!
score.praise50: Pretty good! Let's practice a few more sentences!
score.praiseLow: Keep going! Let's practice sentence by sentence!
score.insufficient: We couldn't hear clearly. Please try again!
score.matchedSummary: You matched {matched}/{evaluated} words in the listened segment.
score.unassessedNote: Not evaluated: {count} words. This part is not counted as incorrect.
score.practiceUnheardLine: Sing again to hear sentence {number} clearly

gate.silence: We couldn't hear your voice yet. Bring the mic a bit closer or check your microphone and try again!
gate.noiseOnly: The room sounds a bit noisy. Please move to a quieter spot or wear headphones!
gate.electricalHum: The microphone has electrical hum. Please ask a parent to check the mic or cable!
gate.bleedHeadphones: Some audio looped back into the mic. Slightly lower headphone volume and sing clearly!
gate.bleedSpeaker: The mic hears speaker music more than your voice. Wear headphones or move closer to the mic!
gate.lowCoverage: You only sang a short part. Sing a few more lines so we can score the full performance!
gate.okHeadphones: Headphone mode helps the mic capture your voice clearly!
gate.okSpeaker: Tip: Wearing headphones helps the mic hear your melody and rhythm most clearly!

encouragement.insufficient: Not enough vocal signal to score this take. Try singing more clearly near the mic!
encouragement.high: Wonderful! You sang on beat, clearly, and with great expression!
encouragement.good: Great job! Your rhythm and melody are coming along nicely!
encouragement.medium: Nice try! Practice the tricky segment at 0.85x speed!
encouragement.low: Keep going! Let's practice line by line at a slower pace!

lineTips.unclear: This line wasn't clear yet—try practicing it slowly at 0.85x!
lineTips.great: Great! You sang this line confidently and right on beat!
lineTips.rhythmLate: You came in slightly late on this line—listen to the music and start a touch earlier!
lineTips.rhythmFast: You sang slightly ahead of the beat—follow the highlighted lyrics steadily!
lineTips.rhythmSteady: Try Rhythm Tap or practice this line at 0.85x speed for steadier timing!
lineTips.pitch: Listen closely to this line's melody and sustain the notes evenly!
lineTips.lyrics: Read this line slowly once, then sing each syllable clearly!
lineTips.practiceMore: Pretty good! One more practice pass at 0.85x will make it even better!
lineTips.insufficientLine: Couldn't hear this line clearly—try singing a bit closer to the mic!

rhythmTap.insufficientGuidance: Tap the rhythm button (or Spacebar) along with each syllable on screen!
rhythmTap.insufficientTip: Try tapping a steady beat along with this line!
rhythmTap.okGuidance: Rhythm Tap helps build a feel for song tempo before singing with a microphone!

musicalScoring.lyricsOnlyFallbackGuidance: Web Audio analysis was not active on this device, so this session scored lyrics only.
musicalScoring.mildSpeakerBleedGuidance: Mild speaker bleed entered the mic. Headphones will make pitch and rhythm scoring even more accurate!

OBSERVE.label: Observe
OBSERVE.cue: Look closely at the picture: who or what do you see, and which colors stand out?
OBSERVE.audioHint: Observe mode. Look closely at the scene and name the most noticeable people, animals, or objects.

VOCABULARY.label: Vocabulary
VOCABULARY.cue: Try including 1–2 suggested words or focus words above in your sentence.
VOCABULARY.audioHint: Vocabulary mode. Pick one or two suggested words above and include them in your description.

SENTENCE.label: Sentence
SENTENCE.cue: Combine who + action + where to form one complete sentence.
SENTENCE.audioHint: Sentence mode. Speak a complete sentence saying who is doing what and where.

STORY.label: Storytelling
STORY.cue: Connect 2–3 sentences to tell what is happening in the story.
STORY.audioHint: Storytelling mode. Link two or three sentences clearly telling what is unfolding in the picture.

INFER.label: Inference
INFER.cue: Why did the character do that? What might happen right before or next?
INFER.audioHint: Inference mode. Guess why the character acted that way or what might happen next.

CREATE.label: Creative
CREATE.cue: Imagine fun dialogue or an exciting ending for this scene!
CREATE.audioHint: Creative mode. Invent funny dialogue or a wonderful next part for this picture.
